title: Priest dialogue option 'release me from my promise' reads as an innocuous question but silently breaks the player's earlier promise to the reeve and immediately fails the 'Barrow Doors' quest, with no confirmation and no warning that the phrasing was itself the irrevocable action.
where: Gray Chapel / talking with gray priest
